title: LLHB per-case result record
description: Raw retained output of one case under one run. Stored as JSONL under results/runs/<run-id>/. Scoring reads these records; they are never edited after capture.

final_answer.description: The model's final answer text, verbatim. Null only when the case errored before an answer.

tool_calls.description: Empty for control. Ordered as issued.

result.description: Always null. A tool result is regenerable from (tool, arguments, corpus pin), so it is never inlined here (owner ruling #27): result_ref points at the payload beside the run and result_sha256 is what an audit checks it against. The field is constrained rather than removed so records written before the rule, which carry an explicit null, stay valid.

result_ref.description: Stable reference to the stored payload (path within the run dir) when not inlined.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON payload; always present when result_ref is used.

truncated.description: True when a max-turn or token cap was hit; recorded, never silently dropped.

completed.description: True when a final answer was captured without a fatal error.

harness.description: The CLI's own account of this case's tool environment, read back from its transcript: what the model was offered, whether the tool backend was up, and what the harness refused. Makes 'the control arm had no tools' checkable instead of asserted (ruling #25). Null for records captured before Stage 6.

exposed_tools.description: Tool names offered to the model. Empty for a valid control case.

mcp_servers.description: Condition 'lovspor': every declared server and its connection status. A case whose server was not connected ran without the treatment.

permission_denials.description: Tool calls the harness blocked. Non-empty means the model was denied a tool it asked for; the case is not a clean measurement of either condition.

raw_response_ref.description: Path within the run dir to the full raw provider response stream, when retained separately.

repeat_index.description: Set only for stability-subset repeats (METHODOLOGY §5); null for the primary pass.
